name: motif_dry_run
description:
Dry Run a Proposal. Queues a Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal on a throwaway copy of its Baseline. Its effects are bound to that content and project state.
Command: dry-run. Agent class: Evaluate.
proposal: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
no_background: True queues no Parsimony Baseline bundle job when the Dry Run runs, so nothing commits after the command returns.
Read a Dry Run. Waits for a Draft or finalized Proposal's Dry Run and prints operation counts, warnings, the Baseline hash and the effects-file path. Add --effects for the full terminal list; --json keeps the full operations and effects arrays with an effectsSummary.
Command: dry-run --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
proposal: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
job: The exact job identity returned when evidence was queued.
wait_seconds: The deadline for normal completion.
wait_terminal: Cancel the job at the deadline and wait for its execution to end.

job.description: A job id from an earlier 'running' result, to keep waiting for it.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 40.

wait_terminal.description: Cancel the job on timeout and wait for its execution to end.

effects.description: Include the complete operation and effects lists in the result.

no_background.description: True queues no Parsimony Baseline bundle job when the Dry Run runs, so nothing commits after the tool returns.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: Page size for paged reads (findings, operations: default 10; proposals list: default 25), and the most list items in concise mode elsewhere (default 25).

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
